text:
maria: Morning async standup — quick updates: what I did yesterday / blockers / today. I'll start: finished benchmark post draft (bench post v3) and scheduled initial images. Blocker: still waiting on final numbers from analytics. Today: pinging @jon for review + prepping newsletter slot.

jon: Reviewed draft, left a few inline comments on the intro and the 'cost per request' chart. No blocker on my side. Can do final pass once analytics numbers land. Pinged @angela for hero image options.

angela: Gotcha, exporting 3 hero image options now. ETA ~1h. FYI ran into an alignment issue with the new template on mobile — @prateek might need a tiny CSS tweak.

prateek: CSS tweak should be minimal, can do once you drop a staging link. Also pushed a small change to /content/bench to update chart colors. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/412

maria: Staging link: https://staging.redwood.ai/content/bench-v3 — @prateek I added a note about the mobile layout in the PR description.

prateek: Saw it, will run CI and merge after tests pass. No blockers from eng side. :shipit: 

angela: Uploaded hero variants to Drive and added filenames in the doc: drive.link/abc123. I also made an alt hero that doesn't rely on the analytics numbers (per maria's contingency).

maria: Great — calendar question: we should slot the bench post Tue AM. @jon can you confirm publish window? Also need approval for paid social copy once posted.

jon: Tue 09:00 PT works. I'll schedule in Contentful and open a separate thread for paid social copy later today.

sophia (marketing-bot): Calendar update posted: 'Bench post v3' scheduled for 2026-03-24 09:00 PT. Reminder set for @maria @jon 24h before.

maria: Thanks bot. Quick blocker: analytics warned there might be a ~2hr delay in report generation tomorrow morning — could delay final numbers. If that happens we'll publish with an 'updated last-24h numbers' note and follow up with an analytics tweet.

angela: Ok, that plan works. I'll prep a quick alt hero that uses the generic CTA so we don't hold the publish.

jon: Sounds good. Any objections to a final QA pass Thursday morning? Need one dev review + one marketing approval.

prateek: Thursday morning QA pass works for me.

maria: Perfect. I'll post a final check-in here once numbers are in and the PR is merged. Thanks everyone :rocket:
